movie_title: Whatever happened to acid rain? - Joseph Goffman
introduction: Discover what causes acid rain, and how scientists were able to largely eliminate this major environ

vocabulary.example: The arboreal ecosystem in the region was threatened by the acid rain.

vocabulary.definition: very small solid particles in the air
vocabulary.example: The air quality worsened due to high levels of particulates from industrial activities.

vocabulary.definition: gradually destroy or damage through a chemical process
vocabulary.example: The acid rain had started to corrode the metal structures in the area.

vocabulary.definition: seek to influence (a politician or public official) on an issue
vocabulary.example: The corporations lobbied against regulations to reduce air pollution.

vocabulary.definition: equipment used to clean gases or remove pollutants
vocabulary.example: The power plants installed scrubbers to reduce emissions of sulfur dioxide.

vocabulary.definition: general agreement among a group of people
vocabulary.example: There was a consensus among scientists that urgent action was needed to combat air pollution.
